- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018
- Primary specializations: OEM precision manufacturing, cost engineering (VAVE), AI-powered manufacturing
- Industries served: Automotive, Aerospace, Medical Devices, Electronics, Defense
